title: Unsubscribe from the newsletter
intro: Your address will be removed from the list. You can tell us why: these reasons are read by the team and used to improve what we send.
recognized: You are recognised by the link you received: just confirm.
noteHint: Nothing is required: the removal is recorded even without a reason.
doneDesc: Your address will no longer receive our e-mails. One last message may still go out if it was already being prepared.
notFound: This address is not on our list. Check the spelling, or use the link sent by e-mail.
error: The removal could not be saved. Please try again in a moment.
privacy: The address and reason are kept only to keep the list accurate.
